root_cause: Some canonical publication decisions persisted delivery_evidence as a JSONB scalar string containing JSON text. The fairness gate expects an object and cannot read generation_retry_after from a scalar, repeatedly choosing the same high-priority failing personal channel and starving the company/blog lanes.
prevention_rule: Coerce double-encoded JSON objects at the one database write boundary using a typed SECURITY INVOKER trigger; reject evidence arrays and invalid values; normalize recent safely decodable data without changing publication status, provider receipts, identity gates, or sender permissions.

production_observation.type_counts: Several recent days contained JSONB strings alongside objects; personal retry_after JSON field invisible until corrected
